name: WF-451 — Portfolio Forecast → Deal Volume, Revenue, Profit & Acquisition Budget Planning Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'').trim(); const forecastPeriods=Math.max(1,Math.min(12,Number(b.forecastPeriods??6))); const asOfDate=String(b.asOfDate??new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)).trim(); return [{json:{...b,portfolioId,forecastPeriods,asOfDate,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Portfolio Forecast Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):0; const hist=Array.isArray(ctx.historicalPeriods)?ctx.historicalPeriods:[]; const flags=[]; if(hist.length===0)flags.push('no_historical_periods'); const avg=(field)=>hist.length?hist.reduce((s,p)=>s+n(p[field]),0)/hist.length:0; const avgLeads=avg('leads'); const avgQualified=avg('qualifiedLeads'); const avgContracts=avg('contracts'); const avgClosed=avg('closedDeals'); const avgRevenue=avg('grossRevenue'); const avgNetProfit=avg('netProfit'); const avgSpend=avg('acquisitionSpend'); const avgLeadToClose=avgLeads>0?avgClosed/avgLeads:0; const avgQualifiedRate=avgLeads>0?avgQualified/avgLeads:0; const avgContractRate=avgQualified>0?avgContracts/avgQualified:0; const avgCloseRate=avgContracts>0?avgClosed/avgContracts:0; const avgProfitPerClosed=avgClosed>0?avgNetProfit/avgClosed:0; const avgSpendPerLead=avgLeads>0?avgSpend/avgLeads:0; const target=ctx.targets??{}; const targetClosed=n(target.closedDealsPerPeriod??target.closedDeals); const targetNetProfit=n(target.netProfitPerPeriod??target.netProfit); const targetRevenue=n(target.grossRevenuePerPeriod??target.grossRevenue); const targetBudget=n(target.acquisitionBudgetPerPeriod??target.acquisitionBudget); const trend=(field)=>{if(hist.length<2)return 0; const first=n(hist[0][field]); const last=n(hist[hist.length-1][field]); return first>0?Math.max(-0.25,Math.min(0.25,(last-first)/first/(hist.length-1))):0;}; const trends={leads:trend('leads'),qualifiedLeads:trend('qualifiedLeads'),contracts:trend('contracts'),closedDeals:trend('closedDeals'),grossRevenue:trend('grossRevenue'),netProfit:trend('netProfit'),acquisitionSpend:trend('acquisitionSpend')}; const periods=[]; for(let i=1;i<=input.forecastPeriods;i++){const leadBase=Math.max(0,avgLeads*(1+trends.leads*i)); const qualified=leadBase*avgQualifiedRate; const contracts=qualified*avgContractRate; const closed=contracts*avgCloseRate; const revenue=closed* (avgClosed>0?avgRevenue/avgClosed:0); const netProfit=closed*avgProfitPerClosed; const spend=leadBase*avgSpendPerLead; periods.push({period:i,projectedLeads:Math.round(leadBase*100)/100,projectedQualifiedLeads:Math.round(qualified*100)/100,projectedContracts:Math.round(contracts*100)/100,projectedClosedDeals:Math.round(closed*100)/100,projectedGrossRevenue:Math.round(revenue*100)/100,projectedNetProfit:Math.round(netProfit*100)/100,projectedAcquisitionSpend:Math.round(spend*100)/100});} const totals=periods.reduce((a,p)=>({leads:a.leads+p.projectedLeads,qualifiedLeads:a.qualifiedLeads+p.projectedQualifiedLeads,contracts:a.contracts+p.projectedContracts,closedDeals:a.closedDeals+p.projectedClosedDeals,grossRevenue:a.grossRevenue+p.projectedGrossRevenue,netProfit:a.netProfit+p.projectedNetProfit,acquisitionSpend:a.acquisitionSpend+p.projectedAcquisitionSpend}),{leads:0,qualifiedLeads:0,contracts:0,closedDeals:0,grossRevenue:0,netProfit:0,acquisitionSpend:0}); const avgPerPeriod=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(totals).map(([k,v])=>[k,input.forecastPeriods?Math.round(v/input.forecastPeriods*100)/100:0])); const closedGap=targetClosed>0?Math.round((targetClosed-avgPerPeriod.closedDeals)*100)/100:0; const profitGap=targetNetProfit>0?Math.round((targetNetProfit-avgPerPeriod.netProfit)*100)/100:0; const revenueGap=targetRevenue>0?Math.round((targetRevenue-avgPerPeriod.grossRevenue)*100)/100:0; const budgetGap=targetBudget>0?Math.round((targetBudget-avgPerPeriod.acquisitionSpend)*100)/100:0; let decision='maintain_current_acquisition_plan'; const actions=[]; if(closedGap>0||profitGap>0){if(avgLeadToClose>=0.03)decision='increase_acquisition_budget_and_pipeline_capacity';else decision='improve_funnel_conversion_before_scaling';} if(budgetGap<0&&avgPerPeriod.acquisitionSpend>targetBudget)actions.push('reduce_or_reallocate_acquisition_spend'); if(closedGap>0)actions.push('increase_qualified_lead_volume_or_improve_close_rate'); if(profitGap>0)actions.push('protect_underwriting_margin_and_improve_deal_profitability'); if(revenueGap>0)actions.push('increase_contract_and_closing_volume'); if(!actions.length)actions.push('maintain_current_acquisition_capacity_and_monitor_forecast'); const confidence=hist.length>=12?90:hist.length>=6?80:hist.length>=3?65:40; const idempotencyKey='wf451:'+input.portfolioId+':'+input.forecastPeriods+':'+input.asOfDate; return [{json:{...input,portfolioForecast:{status:hist.length?'forecast_ready':'insufficient_data',decision,historicalPeriodCount:hist.length,baseline:{avgLeads,avgQualifiedLeads:avgQualified,avgContracts,avgClosedDeals:avgClosed,avgGrossRevenue:avgRevenue,avgNetProfit:avgNetProfit,avgAcquisitionSpend:avgSpend,avgLeadToCloseRate:avgLeadToClose,avgProfitPerClosed:avgProfitPerClosed,avgSpendPerLead:avgSpendPerLead},trends,forecastPeriods:periods,totals,avgPerPeriod,targetGaps:{closedDealsGap:closedGap,netProfitGap:profitGap,grossRevenueGap:revenueGap,acquisitionBudgetGap:budgetGap},recommendedActions:actions,flags,confidenceScore:confidence},idempotencyKey}}];

main.node: Calculate Forecast Volume Revenue Profit & Budget Demand

meta.notes: Forecasts deal volume, revenue, profit and acquisition-spend demand from historical portfolio periods and produces budget/capacity actions. Production use requires calibrated forecasting models, canonical accounting definitions, validated acquisition-spend data, target schema and production InsulaCRM API contracts.
